It's a night to make the guys wonder if they'd be better off just sticking to The Cowboy Way of life they love.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: The Hunt for Outlaw Bill Doolin
programme.desc: When notorious outlaw Bill Doolin escapes from jail, the U.S. Marshals Service springs into action to end his four-year crime spree. Known as the Three Guardsmen, Deputy U.S. Marshals Heck Thomas, Bill Tilghman, and Chris Madsen have a reputation for always getting their man, but they know it won't be easy with Doolin. Doolin is no ordinary outlaw: as a former member of The Dalton Gang and the mastermind of The Wild Bunch, he has successfully robbed banks, trains, and stagecoaches. After months of tracking Doolin, Heck Thomas is so close he barely stops to eat or sleep. When Thomas and his posse finally corner Doolin, he refuses to surrender, and gunfire is the only way out. Some years later, Bat Masterson, former-gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, catches up with Bill Tilghman to hear the real story behind the hunt for the outlaw Bill Doolin.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: While working as a groundskeeper at a convent in Ohio, former slave Mary Fields forms a deep friendship with the superior, Mother Amadeus Dunne. When Mother Amadeus falls ill after traveling to Montana to open a girls' school, Mary rushes to her rescue and nurses her back to health. Mary soon discovers that the Western Frontier satisfies her free-spirited nature, and she decides to stay in Montana for good. She secures a contract to deliver mail by stagecoach for the U.S. Postal Service, becoming the first African American woman to carry mail. With a fearless attitude and multiple firearms, she protects the mail from would-be bandits and is soon known far and wide. Some years later, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman Bat Masterson meets Sister Amadeus and gets the true story of Stagecoach Mary.

programme.sub-title: Annie Oakley: Rise of a Shooting Star
programme.desc: After her father's death, nine-year-old Annie Oakley first picks up a rifle and begins shooting small game in order to feed her siblings and support her widowed mother. By her teenage years, Annie is so good at hunting that she begins supplying meat to a local grocery store, earning enough money to pay off her mother's mortgage. When famed sharpshooter Frank Butler comes to town for an exhibition, Annie accepts his challenge to participate in a shooting match. Not only does she win the match, but she wins Butler's heart as well. They are soon married, but they struggle to make it as a team on stage. A better shooter, Annie must become the main attraction for them to succeed. Years later, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman Bat Masterson, tracks down Annie's husband to learn more about the rise of this shooting star.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Charles M. Russell: The Cowboy Artist
programme.desc: Charlie Russell is an aimless cowhand who loves the freedom of the cowboy way of life, and he is a self-taught artist who enjoys capturing the scenes of his rugged work on the range. Too embarrassed to ask people to pay for his paintings, he gives most of them away to friends or trades them for drinks at the saloon. But that changes quickly after he falls in love. Charlie's new bride Nancy gives him the encouragement he needs to stop cowboying in order to focus on his artwork. Under her watchful eye, he sobers up, stops cowboying, and improves his mastery of painting. Nancy is so proud of Charlie's talent that she doesn't hesitate to ask top dollar for his paintings. Years later, when legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman Bat Masterson tries to do a piece on Charlie, he quickly realizes that he must first deal with the woman behind the famous cowboy artist Charles M. Russell.

programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Backstabbing takes many forms - lying, spreading gossip and fueling nasty rumors. Dr. Phil's guests say the ultimate betrayal didn't come from a stranger, but from their own sister!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: On the Outs With the In-Laws
programme.desc: Manipulative, violent, controlling, downright diabolical. These are some of the words Anna-Laura uses to describe her mother-in-law, Janice. Anna-Laura says her mother-in-law has threatened to take her children away, calls 12-15 times per day, peeks in their windows, goes through their trash, drives to Anna-Laura’s house and points her finger – from her car- as if she is pulling the trigger of a gun. Morgan says his mother also opens the front door and walks into their home unannounced. Anna-Laura says she got a restraining order against her mother-in-law after Janice hit her, which Janice denies. She says Janice is forcing her husband, Morgan, to choose between his mother and his wife. What can this family do to get along with one another?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Natalie says her husband, Brian, was in a tragic work accident in 2015 when he fell from a 68-foot crane. She says he was paralyzed from the knees down and claims he has stopped trying to live life. Natalie claims that since the accident, Brian has treated her and their 13-year old son, Jacob, like his slaves instead of his family. Natalie says her marriage with Brian has changed, and they don’t know how to communicate with one another. Brian says his family doesn’t understand what he is going through and that he is in too much pain to move. Brian also says Natalie’s parents, Sharyn and Dave, are too involved in his family’s lives, which is causing tension. Sharyn and Dave say they were trying to help their daughter since Natalie took on all of the responsibilities in her household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The intense behavior of mothers who constantly monitor their children is examined and put to the test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How much should looking good factor into your relationship? Today’s guests say appearance matters, and their mate is not up to their standards! Sandi says after six years of marriage, she misses her husband, Otto’s, six-pack. He says working -- not working out -- is a priority for him, and nothing will satisfy his wife, who rates herself a 20 out of 10. But the couple does agree on one thing: whatever Sandi wants, Sandi gets. Will Otto agree to hit the gym? Then, Dawn worked hard to shed 150 pounds, and when the new svelte Dawn met Paul, sparks flew! He thought she was hot -- until she undressed. What is she hiding? Plus, discover why Dr. Phil wrestles with his decision to help Dawn and Paul. And, Cynthia says she’s embarrassed by her boyfriend’s outdated wardrobe, and refuses to be seen with him in public! Can a professional makeover change her opinion?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there something you’ve been hanging on to for just a little too long? Clothes you haven’t fit into since high school? Boxes of stuff you haven’t looked at in years? Dr. Phil’s guests say their loved ones need to call the junk yard and “Get rid of it!” Kim says her husband, Paul’s, Star Warshobby has to go. With over 6,000 pieces in his collection, Paul spends 30 hours a week playing with his action figures, building models and talking to friends about Star Wars. He even had a light saber sword fight at their wedding, so shouldn’t Kim have known what she was getting into? Next, Larry and Sheila married four months ago, but Sheila says she had no idea she was getting hitched to a hoarder. Larry says she’s got it all wrong -– she’s the pack rat! With some of their favorite collections rolled out on stage, can Dr. Phil help them negotiate what goes and what stays? Plus, meet Terri, who has four storage units and two garages full of sentimental memories -– like a rubber chicken and her father’s spine X-rays! She spends so much money storing her stuff, that she can’t even afford health insurance. What’s at the heart of her hoarding? Don’t miss this hilarious look at how collections can get out of control!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dan and Teresa say their 16-year-old identical twins, Dallas and Drew are violent, destructive and dangerous, and they fear someone will end up seriously hurt, or even dead. What’s at the root of the teens’ anger and extreme jealousy that’s driving them apart? Could the parents be contributing to the explosive situation? Broken bones, violent fights, destruction of property -- today’s guests aren’t enemies; they are 16-year-old identical twin brothers. Dr. Phil examines the jealousy and torment that's driving these siblings apart and throwing their home into chaos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amie says she has no idea how to control her 7-year-old son, Jayden, and even began posting videos of his outbursts online seeking help. But Jayden’s father, Chad, says Amie is just out for attention and blames her for their son’s problems. Can these exes learn to co-parent peacefully?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they are overworked and overwhelmed moms who are at their breaking points. First, Miranda, 21, is a mother of two and says that she’s responsible for all of the household chores while her husband, Dakota, 23, plays golf, gambles and hangs out with his friends. Miranda says she cries almost every day and feels resentful toward her husband. Dakota admits he likes to have a good time but says that he works hard to support his family and feels that Miranda should be responsible for all of the housework. He says that his young wife gets easily overstressed and that she is the problem. Can Dr. Phil help these two negotiate a plan that works for both of them? Then, Jessa has 10 kids, including 1-year-old triplets, and admits she’s overwhelmed but says her controlling nature makes it hard to delegate household tasks. Her husband, Jeremy, says Jessa takes care of everyone -- except herself. Professional organizer, Julie Morgenstern, takes a trip to Jessa’s home. Can she help Jessa streamline her daily tasks and put herself first?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil gives family freeloaders a wake-up call.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Pierre, his wife, Amanda, and his mother, Yolande, came to see Dr. Phil, the couple complained his mom was a meddling-mother-in-law. Amanda said Yolande never approved of her, and Yolande admitted she wanted her son to be with a more educated woman. Is this family still at odds?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The honeymoon is over! Dr. Phil talks with newlyweds about their troubles, and he and Robin share some stories of how they make their marriage work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brandon is a drug addict in recovery who credits Dr. Phil’s intervention with saving his life. Now, he and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by staging interventions for families and their drug addicted loved ones. Dee saw an episode with Brandon and wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old twin daughters, Brooke and Tiffany, who are addicted to heroin and other prescription drugs. Both women have young children, who are often left to parent each other, as well as take care of their sick mothers. Dee and her husband, Danny, and their two other children, Ashley and Derrick, are united in the goal to save the girls’ lives, but will they be prepared when Dr. Phil makes them all take a hard look at themselves? Find out why Dr. Phil says the whole family is sick. Will the twins agree to treatment? And what will happen to their children? Don’t miss this shocking story!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A headline making story of a husband’s affair with a co-worker that led to murder. Now the wife and the mistress come face to face for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One man says he caught his wife cheating – on audiotape – but she denies the accusations. Who’s really telling the truth? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of the alleged affair on tape. Can this relationship survive without trust?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.sub-title: Demon Panthers, Helicopter Crew Meets UFO, Doppleganger
programme.desc: Everyday people share first-hand accounts of their close encounters with real-life folktale fiends. From legendary monsters and ancient spirits to UFOs and unexplained phenomena, the most frightening tales are revealed.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: My black triangle UFO sighting & Rendlesham Forest UFO encounter Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode of “The Basement Office,” Steven Greenstreet reveals a close encounter he had with a black, triangular UFO in Provo, Utah, in 2003. Nick Pope helps Steven come to terms with what he saw, and helps explain why so many similar UFO sightings go unreported. Then, Charles Halt discusses his shock at his UFO sighting in Rendlesham Forest in 1980 and the audio recording he made during the event.

programme.title: Cryptid Wilds S02 E03

programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team continues their visit to Bihl Manor in Fremont, Ohio, a 19th-century home later turned children’s group residence. Surrounded by stories of ghostly children, shadowy figures, and mysterious footsteps, the manor has earned a lasting reputation as one of the region’s most haunted sites—where the line between legend and reality may not be as distant as it seems.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates

programme.title: Gutta Mamis
programme.desc: Shinette and Tierra have always vowed to ride-or-die for one another. So when opportunity knocks, it's time to do what they do best — get to the bag! It was supposed to go down like all of the others, except this time, they walk away from the scene with a body on their hands. As long as Tierra sticks to the script and doesn't utter a word, there's nothing to worry about. But once fear and desperation seep in, it's not long before she finds herself confiding in her on-again-off-again boyfriend, Duke — breaking her pact and setting off a chain of events that leaves every woman for herself. Their chase to get the bag, just might land them inside of one!

programme.title: In This House

Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programme.title: Kingsmen

programme.title: Complexx: The Two Exes

When the two women end up moving into his building, they begin a war of manipulation, on top of a masked killer running through the building. Who will make it out alive?

programme.title: The Lineup

Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: The Brute and the Beast

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: Night of the Serpent
programme.desc: In a corrupt Mexican village, Commander Hernandez and his men plot to steal young Manuel’s inheritance. When the broken ex-gunslinger Luke is drawn into their scheme by the revolutionary Pancho, betrayal and vengeance ignite in a tale of greed and redemption.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: They Call Me Hallelujah

His mission spirals into chaos as he faces bandits, spies, impostors, and schemers in a wild chase through danger and deception.

programme.title: Poker with Pistols
programme.desc: After losing everything in a poker game, Lucas takes a risky job delivering a wagon to Chamaco for $5000. But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff

programme.title: Taste of Killing

programme.title: Sugar Colt
programme.desc: In order to avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Rocco has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.

Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

At first united to carry out the plan, the gang members, however, allow themselves to be carried away by inexperience and avarice, each of them thinking of their own gain.

programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Man With a Plan
programme.desc: Adam has been operating under the assumption that his three children are little angels, but when his wife decides to rejoin the workforce after being a stay-at-home mom for 13 years, and he starts taking on more of the parenting responsibilities, he's quickly disavowed of that notion. Kate, a preteen, is a master manipulator and excited to take advantage of her father's naivete; Teddy spends too much time with his hands down his pants; and Emme frets over school. After recovering from the initial shock -- and with the advice of equally stressed parents Marie and Lowell -- Adam is confident he can lay down the law and keep the house in order.

Now, the festival lends its famous name to this hidden-camera prank show starring a Quebec-based troupe. Canada is the stage and its inhabitants are the characters -- some might say victims -- for the "Candid Camera"-style pranks featured on the half-hour series. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.desc: Sam, Easkey, and Adrien catch up with West African surf legend Oumar Seye, the first West African sponsored surfer. Seye has impacted the surf culture in Senegal in more ways than one, both proving the sport can be more than a hobby and supporting sustainability by banning plastic bags at his surf events. They end their trip in Popenguine, a bohemian beach town where an incredible women-led initiative to plant thousands of trees has made the area one of the greenest parts of the country.

The beauty of Teahupo'o is how it disguises its brutality. In Tahiti, it's no longer about surviving the season. It's about earning the right to fight for a World Title.

programme.title: 2024 TUDOR NAZARÉ Big Wave Challenge | REPLAY
programme.desc: The Big Wave tour resumed after 2 years at Nazaré to pristine conditions as the TUDOR Nazaré Big Wave Challenge started to roll. Watch as Big Wave heavies displayed critical teamwork to tow into massive Nazaré. Nazaré, Portugal is home to the biggest waves on Earth. In the TUDOR Nazaré Big Wave Challenge, two-person teams made up of men and women take turns surfing and driving the jetski as they compete in potentially record-setting surf. The WSL Big Wave season is the time of year when humans push the boundaries of what’s possible on a surfboard. In the sport’s premier paddle-only event at Jaws and tow surfing challenge at Nazaré, these men and women drop in and charge the impossible for the ride of a lifetime.

programme.title: 2025 TUDOR NAZARÉ Big Wave Challenge | REPLAY

Heavy wipeouts, full sends, and a clash of defending champs taking on perennial Big Wave standouts provided plenty of adrenaline-pumping action. Nic Von Rupp and Clement Roseyro emerged victorious with Justine Dupont stamping her authority at the arena of Nazaré once more to top the women's leaderboard alongside Roseyro taking the men's leaderboard win.

programme.title: 2023 Billabong Pro Pipeline Finals Day | REPLAY

Everyone enters the season with equal hopes of winning it all. The rookie class is thrown into the fire, the contenders return with one thing on their minds, and the surf world begins to follow the road to the Rip Curl WSL Finals. Pipeline sets the tone.

programme.title: Lost Classics

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They’re looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer’s home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won’t end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro’s remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.title: HEALTH EXPLORED.101.Human Performance
programme.desc: In the season premiere, Dr. David Behm explores the science of elite athletic performance. From lab insights to real-world training with NHL pros and coach Ben Prentiss, we discover how peak performance shapes health and everyday strength.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E07 - Cornwall NB
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E08 - St. Pete NB
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.sub-title: Caves: Kandovan Village, Iran; Matera, Italy
programme.desc: We have always been fascinated by what lies beneath our feet. Some cultures have feared the underworlds, while others have believed that the earth houses our ancestors.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We're going to South America to see one of the largest cenotes in the world. This Great Blue Hole is part of the Belize Barrier Reef Reserve System. We'll know the ruins of the monuments of the ancient Mayan civilization and will visit part of its history. From the depths of the ocean to the top of the hill on which the Castle of San Jorge sits, we will land in Lisbon, Portugal to experience everything that this ancient city has to offer. Its culture, its customs, temples, and beautiful squares will be the route to discover this beautiful city. Finally, we'll go to the jungle in a journey through a river that only the bravest explorers dared to cross. Lets go to the Amazon! We will admire the variety of Amazonian fauna. We will see some of the animals that live there, like the dolphins, giant otters, even piranhas!

La Nena y Theo tambi n tiene su noche buena, el cree que se la comi regal ndole una bater a nueva para su carrito, ella piensa que como le dice que el carro que el vio abajo en la calle es su regalo de navidad que al lado del suyo que da totalmente nulo. En la casa de Gladis tambi n la est n pasando muy bien, ya Gabriel no aguanta mas con las miradas que le lanza Gladis, le advierte que no lo siga mirando de esa manera por que despu s ella no lo va aceptar y le va salir con una de las de ella, en el momento en que ya Gabito tiene casi convencida a Gladis para que la sigan pasando bien, pero solo ellos dos, se aparece un San Nicol s cargado de regalos cuando voltean a ver quien es, sorpresa es Remedios que llego de nuevo, bueno la cara que pone Gabito es todo un poema.

R mulo esta molesto pues la familia de Betzaida amaneci y el ten a tiempo que no hac a algo as , decide pasar delante de la casa de Eglee, aprovecha que Betzaida se quedo dormida, pero cuando pasa ve que Santiago sale de la casa como a hurtadillas y el se pone furioso, tanto que despert a Betzaida quien le reclama que hace el all , que ya esa no es su casa y que se vayan para la suya de inmediato. programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 93: La Nena y la Competencia Fuerte
programme.desc: Ya Gerson meti la pata, y Theo descubre que su millonaria le oculta algo y grave, pues no es cualquier zamuro es que esta detr s de su Mar a Antonia es nada mas y nada menos que un millonario, que adem s de tener tremenda camioneta le manda exquisiteces, no como el que llego con un piche pan de jam n, o sea que la competencia es fuerte. Llega Gladis a la bodega de Gabito para recoger a su hijo e irse a trabajar, pero cuando ve a Remedios, lanza la primera indirecta, que claro que como va a conseguir Remedios pasaje para Yaritagua y si no lo busca menos va encontrar, Gabito se siente de manos atadas, le pide a Gladis que lo escuche pero nada la mujer sale brava en compa a de su hijo. La Nena se entera que su hija fue a visitar a su pap al hotel, la Nena no puede creer lo que su hija le cuenta, despu s de tanto sacrificio, de tanto trabajo que pasaron juntas, ahora se presenta de nuevo este hombre y como trae dinero y regalos a la hija se le ocurre perdonarle todo el da o que a os atr s les hizo pasar, Tatiana le explica sus motivos y que ella si esta dispuesta a perdonar a su pap , la Nena esta indignada y mas rabia le da cuando se aparece el personaje con un par de entradas para ir al teatro y su hija le dice que ella si ir que ella no va a desaprovechar eso, la Nena hierve de la rabia, el Aristigueta le dice que se entero de un chisme pero que quiere saber que hay de cierto en eso, ella se pone alerta, el le dice que se entero que ella se hab a casado con un tal Doroteo Rinc n e ir nicamente le dice que el no se la imagina a ella casada con otro hombre, y como no la ve en compa a de ese tal Doroteo presume que fue otro fracaso mas su matrimonio, la Nena indignada hasta mas no poder, lo corre otra vez del apartamento y una vez a solas llora sin consuelo por que dentro de todo Aristigueta tiene la raz n su boda con Theo fue otro fracaso en su vida. Dileidi le cuenta a su amiga que ahora ya no solo esta enamorada de su novio sino que tambi n siente admiraci n por el, Yenilu le cuenta que ahora si perdi a su amiga por que eso de que ahora lo admire tambi n, quiere decir mucho. La misma conclusi n saca Eglee de su hijo, cuando este le confiesa que siente una gran admiraci n por Dileidi, es tan pobre y tan fajada, que sencillamente adem s de quererla ahora la admira. En casa de Matilde casi se forma otra pelea, Ernesto tiene cosas que hacer y Gonzalo se molesta por que no se queda con sus hermanitos, pero Matilde a tiempo le pide a su marido que por lo menos por ese d a no discuta. En la casa de Pascuita, Gladis se da cuenta que Felicita esta mal, ojerosa, no come nada, la ve verde, se lo dice a su mam , pero que va esta lo nico que le interesa es quedar embarazada ese d a, y cuando Monchito sale a despedirse ella lo agarra y hace que se devuelva pues cree que ese d a si puede quedar en estado, y no le pone atenci n a la salud de su hija, quien a su vez niega que este anor xica y dice que ser hombre tiene mas ventajas que ser mujer, a lo que Gladis le responde con una de las suyas y sucesivamente todas la mujeres del capitulo salen exponiendo una a una las ventajas de ser mujer. En la oficina todos llegan tarde incluida Matilde, que llega disculp ndose, Ram n le presenta a su equipo de trabajo y se lleva la sorpresa de saber que la muchacha que le vend a el peri dico en las ma anas es pasante de ingenier a y que tambi n participa en el proyecto. Mar a Gracia y Cristina hacen ejercicios, pues la miss piensa que con Dileidi metida en la oficina ella tiene que ponerse cada d a mejor de lo que esta, pues cree que la muchacha es mucha competencia para ella, Gerson las ve y Cristina se enorgullece de que el se haya fijado en ella y le haya dicho un piropo, le dice a su compa era que ella no ser miss pero que tambi n tiene lo suyo. programme.desc: R mulo aprovecha que llego Eglee y la enfrenta, le pregunta que paso en ese cuarto, ella se queda muda, pues no sabe exactamente a que se debe la pregunta, le explica que ella para cambiar su cuarto no tiene que pedirle opini n a nadie, el luego de criticar la decoraci n le dice que el se refiere es a que estaba haciendo Santiago hasta altas horas de la madrugada en la casa, que ya el sab a que ninguno de los dos hab a ido a la fiesta de Pascuita, ya Eglee entiende que R mulo sabe o sospecha algo, le pregunta que por que la sigue y de paso le recuerda que ya el tiene otra familia y que se encargue de su nueva mujer, que por cierto no debe saber que el la esta celando con otro hombre. R mulo queda desconcertado pues Eglee ni lo neg ni lo afirmo, o se que, quedo pero que cuando no le hab a preguntado nada. Mientras tanto Betzaida esta furiosa pues su marido no aparece por ninguna parte, le cuenta a su mam que R mulo se hab a parado enfrente de la casa de su ex y Nely para tratar de calmar la rabia de su hija trata de justificar a R mulo, cosa que a Betzaida le molesta mucho. Theo por su parte esta feliz, les da la noticia que le consigui un toque al grupo musical, todos se quedan locos pues ellos nunca pensaron que Theo se fuera a tomar las cosas tan en serio, al principio todos dijeron que no pero como Jos Tadeo entiende que el lo que quiere es levantarse a su millonaria entonces deciden ayudarlo y tocar n la semana pr xima. En la oficina se quedan trabajando hasta tarde, Santiago los quiere dejar solos a Luis Fernando y a Dileidi, busca un motivo para irse, pero Luis Fernando le ofrece la cola a Dileidi, pero cuando est n a punto de salir se aparece Aureliano y le ofrece a Dileidi llevarla hasta su casa, Luis Fernando se pone bravo, en ese momento tambi n se aparece la miss, y entonces Luis Fernando se saca la piedrita y coquetea con ella delante de Dileidi, quien aprovecha para decirle a la miss que ahora ella trabaja con su profe papi en la misma oficina, la miss se controla y no le queda mas remedio que felicitarla. Rosa habla con su hija le saca con mucha sutileza e inteligencia lo que paso la noche anterior con Santiago, a Eglee no le queda otra que contarle a su mam que si que paso una noche maravillosa con el muchacho, a lo que su madre le da el visto bueno, le aconseja que lo disfrute que ella conoce varias amigas suyas que tambi n tiene relaciones con hombres mucho mas j venes que ellas, pero Eglee le aclara que en su caso es mas dif cil pues se trata del mejor amigo de su hijo, tambi n le cuenta que ya R mulo sospecha algo pues le estuvo preguntando cualquier cantidad de cosas, Rosa disfruta del chisme como nunca. Gladis lleva a Yuraima a estudiar ya que parece que el Gerson no ir mas bueno no le queda de otra que entonces intentarlo con su nuera, quien asiste muy entusiasmada a su primer d a de clase. Aristigueta no puede creer que su amigo Marco Aurelio este enamorado, sobre todo el que no cree en las relaciones de pareja, pero Marco Aurelio se defiende diciendo que con la mujer que esta saliendo le pasa algo extra o, esa mujer le inspira muchas cosas a la vez, que el la ayuda no por que ella lo necesite pues ya le ha demostrado que para ella o hay obst culo cuando de su familia se trata, total es una mujer fuera de serie en la que Aristigueta nunca se fijar a. Tatiana se re ne con su pap , quiere escuchar ahora la versi n de el, pues solo sabe lo que le ha dicho la Nena de su pap , el por supuesto que le dice cualquier cantidad de mentiras, que ellas son lo mas importante en su vida, que esta arrepentido, que la nica mujer que vale la pena es su mam en fin la muchacha le cree todo el cuento inclusive que esta enfermo y hasta que le dio un infarto. Gonzalo le da la buena noticia a su mujer que le consigui un trabajo para el proyecto del centro comercial que est n construyendo, ella por supuesto que no lo puede creer, le pregunta a Ram n si es verdad que su marido la sugiri a ella y a Ram n no le quedo otra que decir que si que fue idea de Gonzalo. Theo llega a la casa de la Nena para contarle que ya consigui el primer contrato, ella cree que quien lo ayudo fue su amigo el doctor y Theo le dice que no, que fue el solo, pero se lleva una sorpresa al ver en la mesa hay toda clase de exquisiteces, la Nena le dice que sus alumnas decidieron darle un aguinaldo y que ella se lo gasto en esas cosas. Dileidi habla claro con Aureliano, le dice que no ella no esta siendo justa con el, que lo esta utilizando para darle celos a Luis Fernando, Aureliano sabe que es as tal cual como ella se lo dice, ella le confiesa que no puede hacer nada que esta enamorada de Luis Fernando. En la casa de Eglee todos comen hallaca, bueno no todos, Mar a Gracia no come en la tardes por aquello de la figura, otra que no come es Felicita quien se ve gorda o sea que tiene a la bulimia bien cerca de ella. R mulo al fin se digna a llegar a la casa de su nueva suegra, su mujer lo recibe con tremendo l o, los padres de ella de nuevo le dan la raz n a el y Betzaida les aclara que ya esta bueno de que siempre lo justifiquen a el y no a ella. Al d a siguiente en la bodega de Gabito Theo le cuenta a su amigo que le pareci extra o ver tanta comida cara en la casa de su millonaria adem s ella le dio un trato anormal, sinti que no fue sincera, Gabito le explica que eso es normal pues ella alguna vez tuvo mucho dinero y esta acostumbrada a comer bien, pero en eso llega el Gerson y les echa el cuento de que esta trabajando en el edificio donde vive la Nena, Theo le pregunta que si la vio y el le cuenta que hasta le tuvo que llevar el mercado al apartamento, mercado que le regalaba un tal jefe con una camioneta ltimo modelo, Theo se angustia descubre que no es solo el quien esta detr s de Mar a Antonia, tiene competencia y para colmo de males millonario de verdad.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 93: La Nena y la Competencia Fuerte
programme.desc: Ya Gerson meti la pata, y Theo descubre que su millonaria le oculta algo y grave, pues no es cualquier zamuro es que esta detr s de su Mar a Antonia es nada mas y nada menos que un millonario, que adem s de tener tremenda camioneta le manda exquisiteces, no como el que llego con un piche pan de jam n, o sea que la competencia es fuerte. Llega Gladis a la bodega de Gabito para recoger a su hijo e irse a trabajar, pero cuando ve a Remedios, lanza la primera indirecta, que claro que como va a conseguir Remedios pasaje para Yaritagua y si no lo busca menos va encontrar, Gabito se siente de manos atadas, le pide a Gladis que lo escuche pero nada la mujer sale brava en compa a de su hijo. La Nena se entera que su hija fue a visitar a su pap al hotel, la Nena no puede creer lo que su hija le cuenta, despu s de tanto sacrificio, de tanto trabajo que pasaron juntas, ahora se presenta de nuevo este hombre y como trae dinero y regalos a la hija se le ocurre perdonarle todo el da o que a os atr s les hizo pasar, Tatiana le explica sus motivos y que ella si esta dispuesta a perdonar a su pap , la Nena esta indignada y mas rabia le da cuando se aparece el personaje con un par de entradas para ir al teatro y su hija le dice que ella si ir que ella no va a desaprovechar eso, la Nena hierve de la rabia, el Aristigueta le dice que se entero de un chisme pero que quiere saber que hay de cierto en eso, ella se pone alerta, el le dice que se entero que ella se hab a casado con un tal Doroteo Rinc n e ir nicamente le dice que el no se la imagina a ella casada con otro hombre, y como no la ve en compa a de ese tal Doroteo presume que fue otro fracaso mas su matrimonio, la Nena indignada hasta mas no poder, lo corre otra vez del apartamento y una vez a solas llora sin consuelo por que dentro de todo Aristigueta tiene la raz n su boda con Theo fue otro fracaso en su vida. Dileidi le cuenta a su amiga que ahora ya no solo esta enamorada de su novio sino que tambi n siente admiraci n por el, Yenilu le cuenta que ahora si perdi a su amiga por que eso de que ahora lo admire tambi n, quiere decir mucho. La misma conclusi n saca Eglee de su hijo, cuando este le confiesa que siente una gran admiraci n por Dileidi, es tan pobre y tan fajada, que sencillamente adem s de quererla ahora la admira. En casa de Matilde casi se forma otra pelea, Ernesto tiene cosas que hacer y Gonzalo se molesta por que no se queda con sus hermanitos, pero Matilde a tiempo le pide a su marido que por lo menos por ese d a no discuta. En la casa de Pascuita, Gladis se da cuenta que Felicita esta mal, ojerosa, no come nada, la ve verde, se lo dice a su mam , pero que va esta lo nico que le interesa es quedar embarazada ese d a, y cuando Monchito sale a despedirse ella lo agarra y hace que se devuelva pues cree que ese d a si puede quedar en estado, y no le pone atenci n a la salud de su hija, quien a su vez niega que este anor xica y dice que ser hombre tiene mas ventajas que ser mujer, a lo que Gladis le responde con una de las suyas y sucesivamente todas la mujeres del capitulo salen exponiendo una a una las ventajas de ser mujer. En la oficina todos llegan tarde incluida Matilde, que llega disculp ndose, Ram n le presenta a su equipo de trabajo y se lleva la sorpresa de saber que la muchacha que le vend a el peri dico en las ma anas es pasante de ingenier a y que tambi n participa en el proyecto. Mar a Gracia y Cristina hacen ejercicios, pues la miss piensa que con Dileidi metida en la oficina ella tiene que ponerse cada d a mejor de lo que esta, pues cree que la muchacha es mucha competencia para ella, Gerson las ve y Cristina se enorgullece de que el se haya fijado en ella y le haya dicho un piropo, le dice a su compa era que ella no ser miss pero que tambi n tiene lo suyo. R mulo ve que Eglee coquetea mucho con Santiago y empieza hacer una encuesta entre sus amigos, al primero que le pregunta es a Gonzalo si cree que Eglee tendr a una relaci n con otro hombre, a lo que Gonzalo le responde que a el que le importa total el ya se caso con Betzaida, luego va con Marco Aurelio le pregunta lo mismo y este le responde que por que no, ella es bella, inteligente, joven y adem s divorciada, R mulo no esta conforme con la respuesta de sus amigos. Gonzalo le cuenta a Pascuita que su mujer esta trabajando con Monchito en la misma oficina y en el mismo proyecto, Pascuita casi se infarta y le dice a Gonzalo que no puede ser eso, que ellos no pueden trabajar juntos, Gladis se da cuenta de lo que pasa y a prop sito deja caer un vaso con agua. Llega la hora de comer en la oficina, Luis Fernando invita a Dileidi, pero esta le dice que ella como no sab a trajo la comida de su casa, cuando ya esta dispuesto a irse a comer con Santiago llega la miss quien lo iba a buscar para que comieran juntos como lo hab an acordado la noche anterior, pero como Luis Fernando no se acordaba se queda dudoso, a la que no le gusto para nada o r eso fue a Dileidi, quien pregunta en voz alta que si ya lo hab an acordado.

programme.desc: Se arma una balacera en casa de Rutila. Mónica escucha los planes de Víctor, sin que él se dé cuenta. Una noticia cambiará los planes de Eunice. Los padres de Esperanza pagan por encontrarla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas está de cacería tras Emiliana. Amenaza con comérsela viva. Investigan el pasado de Rutila y aunque niega todo, cuando Castillo se va, ella se quiebra. Él está muy cerca de la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se abre camino en México para hacer negocios a lo grande. El presidente la espera en Toluca y allí ventilan el pasado. Salazar desenreda el negocio de las metanfetaminas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor pone una condición y es inflexible. Aurelio y sus hombres armados preparan el ataque contra él. Las cuatro toneladas de cocaína van rumbo a su destino. Mónica rechaza a Omar como hombre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se desata la balacera. Aurelio accionó el arma y su blanco fue Víctor, Casillas cree que lo mató. Todos se retiran, la Marina está por llegar. Tony Pastrana está a punto de ser excarcelado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar decide ocultar información a la prensa. Rodrigo asegura a Salazar y a Colón que se quedará a su lado para destapar al narco presidente. Se entera que Sebastián es un infiltrado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio va a Cuba y se reúne con Penumbra para hacer negocios, pero no todo sale bien. Casillas amenaza con romper el tratado de paz. Víctor decide trabajar a escondidas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Nace la alianza entre Tony Pastrana y Mónica Robles. Ella jura vengarse de Aurelio cuando se levante, por haberle quitado a su hijo. El presidente pierde la compostura, al sentirse amenazado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio planea todo para intervenir la cuenta de Rutila, quiere sacar cinco millones de dólares. Ismael, molesto con su padre. Se cae el negocio de Mónica. Piensa en Rutila para lavar dinero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Colón garantiza la vida de Esperanza, como Marta Rangel. Ella le advierte sobre el Diablo que acaba de despertar. Javi visita a la Felina como aliado de Casillas. Dalvio sufre una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dalvio y Víctor se enfrentan con armas. Cansado, Dalvio enfrenta a Aurelio y se amenazan con pistolas. Colón traslada a Esperanza como testigo protegido a una casa de seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se arma una balacera en casa de Rutila. Mónica escucha los planes de Víctor, sin que él se dé cuenta. Una noticia cambiará los planes de Eunice. Los padres de Esperanza pagan por encontrarla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana piensa en el punto débil de Aurelio para vengarse. Colón y Rodrigo hablan de él y el ascenso de la droga en Estados Unidos. Rutila nota que la robaron. Doble 30 y Mónica planean la última carga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma su traición a Feyo Aguilera. Le sugieren no enfrentar a los Maras y los Emes, que el gobierno lo haga, pero él rechaza la idea. Víctor quiere recuperar a Mónica. Rastrean a la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una furibunda Rutila encara a su padre, por robarle su dinero. Pastrana ubica a uno de los hijos de Aurelio. Mónica reclama a Víctor la trata de blancas. Penumbra intenta extorsionar a Javier.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana llega a Colombia para vengarse de los Casillas. Ordena el primer asesinato. Interrogan a Arelys y, asustada, informa sobre Juan Carlos y Pina. Rivero vigila a Dalvio y la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doble 30 le ofrece tres toneladas de droga a Aurelio. Casillas protesta. El paramilitar lo amenaza con entregarlo a las autoridades o a Víctor. Mónica pide que la dejen ir. Víctor se deprime.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El recado de Tony llega a oídos de Aurelio. Casillas enfurece por la muerte de su hijo, Nazareno. Piensa en la guerra que se desatará y cómo cuidarse. Tocan el corazón de la Felina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Inauguran el local de Víctor, pero pronto la fiesta se convertirá en un escenario de horror y pánico. Juan Carlos intenta sobornar a un agente federal. La Felina recibe una visita inesperada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del caos, Sebastián ayuda a Rutila. Necesita un buen abogado para presentar las quejas al presidente, luego de que un guardia le quitara el celular. Le llaman la atención a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar muerde el anzuelo que le tiende Rodrigo y se presenta con Castillo en busca de Rutila. Los periodistas lo estan esperando. Para no verse involucrado, destituye a Rodrigo.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

Barney reminds him of the wonderful world of books, and the little dinos decide to write a book of their ownbased on the exciting true-life adventures of Captain Pickles!

But, once theyre gone, she discovers she misses them more than she expected and the more time that goes by, the more she misses them! Barney shows Baby Bop ways to keep friends close in our hearts while theyre away.

BJ and Baby Bop hope to visit them soon. When Baby Bop catches Barney, BJ, Riff and some children wrapping a mysterious present in the caboose, she just cant wait to see what is in the box. Barney suggests they listen to a story while they wait. Baby Bop finally gets to open her present and realizes that sometimes waiting is a good thing!

programme.title: Barney and Friends

In the end, everyone is included for a day of fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends

With their help, the princess finds her song and is delighted to sing it for her friends!

programme.title: Barney and Friends

programme.title: Barney and Friends

Ahora, Carmín crece y vive en Barranquitas, un pintoresco pueblo montañoso en el centro de Puerto Rico, bajo el cuidado de su abuela, una mujer firme y de convicciones conservadoras. La llegada inesperada de su padre Rubén, después de años en prisión, trae consigo una mezcla de alivio por su presencia y complicaciones por las ambigüedades en su relación. - Ahora, Carmín se enfrenta a aprender a vivir entre el abandono y la cautela, mientras navega entre la ausencia, el deseo y el amor.
